questions.q: 7. A: Who fixed the lock on the door for him? B: No one. He fixed it [BLANK].
questions.explanation: He fixed it himself.

questions.q: 8. A: Who is going to come with you? B: Nobody. I'm going by [BLANK].
questions.explanation: By myself = sendirian.

questions.q: 9. We have lots of paint in the garage, so we're going to paint the house [BLANK].
questions.explanation: We are going to paint the house ourselves.

questions.q: 10. A: Did a travel agency organise their holiday? B: No, they organised it [BLANK].
questions.explanation: They organised it themselves.

exercises.title: Latihan 3: Mengoreksi Kesalahan Kalimat (Error Correction)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah koreksi kata ganti refleksif yang tepat untuk memperbaiki kalimat.

questions.q: 1. Megan wasn't able to pay for a new laptop itself. → Kata yang benar menggantikan 'itself':
questions.explanation: Subjek adalah Megan (perempuan), sehingga kata yang benar adalah 'herself'.

questions.q: 2. I taught I how to play the piano last year. → Kata yang benar menggantikan 'I':
questions.explanation: Bentuk refleksif untuk I adalah 'myself'.

questions.q: 3. Dylan and Andrew cooked dinner for ourselves yesterday as I was at work. → Kata yang benar:
questions.hint: Dylan and Andrew adalah orang ketiga jamak (they).
questions.explanation: Dylan dan Andrew (they) memasak untuk diri mereka sendiri ('themselves').

questions.q: 4. B: No, it's fine, I can find it yourself. → Kata yang benar menggantikan 'yourself':
questions.explanation: Subjek 'I can find it...' memerlukan refleksif 'myself'.

questions.q: 5. Max and Julia, you can collect the package from the post office yourself. → Kata yang benar:
questions.hint: Max dan Julia adalah dua orang (kamu jamak).
questions.explanation: Berbicara kepada dua orang (you jamak) bentuk refleksifnya adalah 'yourselves'.

questions.q: 6. We baked a cake for Kim's birthday myself. → Kata yang benar menggantikan 'myself':
questions.explanation: Subjek 'We' memerlukan refleksif 'ourselves'.

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Melengkapi Kalimat dan Memeriksa Audio (Audio TR 7)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan rekaman audio TR 7 dan lengkapi kalimat dengan kata kerja dan kata ganti refleksif yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. Tony [BLANK] with the scissors.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 7: 'Tony cut himself with the scissors.'

questions.q: 2. Don't worry about them. They can [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Audio TR 7: 'Don't worry about them. They can take care of themselves.'

questions.q: 3. The girl was lucky when she fell off her bike that she didn't badly [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Audio TR 7: '...she didn't badly hurt herself.'

questions.q: 4. Be careful! The oven is on. Don't [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Audio TR 7: 'Don't burn yourself.'

questions.q: 5. William and Jeff climbed to the top of the mountain by [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Audio TR 7: 'William and Jeff climbed to the top of the mountain by themselves.'

questions.q: 6. They accidentally left their keys in the house so they couldn't open it. They [BLANK] out by mistake.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 7: 'They locked themselves out by mistake.'

questions.q: 7. It's not our fault. We shouldn't [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Audio TR 7: 'We shouldn't blame ourselves.'

questions.q: 8. I'm such a fool! I could [BLANK]!
questions.explanation: Audio TR 7: 'I could kick myself!'

questions.q: 9. The exhibition was great. We really [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Audio TR 7: 'We really enjoyed ourselves.'

questions.q: 10. I don't want you to pay for me. I'll pay for [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Audio TR 7: 'I'll pay for myself.'

exercises.title: Latihan 5: Penggunaan Reflexive Pronoun Hanya Jika Diperlukan
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk kata kerja yang tepat. Perhatikan bahwa beberapa kata kerja tidak lazim memakai kata ganti refleksif.

questions.q: 1. Some people are very selfish. They only [BLANK].
questions.explanation: 'think of themselves' adalah frasa yang tepat.

questions.q: 2. You work too hard. You should [BLANK] more.
questions.hint: Kata kerja relax tidak membutuhkan kata ganti refleksif.
questions.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris, 'relax' tidak diikuti reflexive pronoun.

questions.q: 3. My husband and I [BLANK] when we were at school.
questions.hint: Kata kerja meet tidak memerlukan refleksif.
questions.explanation: 'meet' sudah bermakna saling bertemu tanpa ourselves.

questions.q: 4. It was a fantastic evening. We really [BLANK].
questions.hint: Kata kerja enjoy membutuhkan reflexive pronoun.
questions.explanation: 'enjoy ourselves' artinya sangat menikmati waktu/bersenang-senang.

questions.q: 5. After Tony had breakfast, he [BLANK].
questions.hint: Kata kerja shave biasa tidak memakai himself.
questions.explanation: Aktivitas mandi, bercukur (shave), berpakaian (dress) biasanya tidak menggunakan refleksif.

questions.q: 6. Tina and Sam, if you want more to drink, [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak untuk mempersilakan orang kedua: 'help yourselves'.

questions.q: 7. I'm trying to [BLANK] to play the guitar but I'm not doing very well.
questions.explanation: 'teach myself' bermakna mengajari diri sendiri.

questions.q: 8. Can you and Alicia [BLANK] some chairs with you when you come to the barbecue?
questions.explanation: Frasa: 'bring some chairs with you', bukan bring yourselves.

questions.q: 9. My baby sister is so clever, she can now [BLANK]. And she's only 2 years old.
questions.explanation: 'feed herself' artinya menyuap makanan ke mulutnya sendiri.

questions.q: 10. I don't need to go to the computer repair shop. My dad can [BLANK].
questions.explanation: 'fix it himself' menunjuk pada kemampuan memperbaiki komputer itu sendiri.

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Pilihan Antara Subject Pronoun atau Reflexive Pronoun
exercises.instruction: Ketik kata ganti subjek (he, she, we, it, you) atau refleksif (himself, itself, myself, yourself, yourselves, ourselves) yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. A: Does [BLANK] wash the car every Saturday morning? B: Yes, usually he does it by [BLANK2].
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan: 'Does he...?', jawaban: 'by himself'.

questions.q: 2. I can't lift all those boxes by [BLANK]. Could you help me?
questions.explanation: By myself bermakna seorang diri tanpa bantuan.

questions.q: 3. Go and look at [BLANK] in the mirror. You have something on your face.
questions.explanation: Look at yourself in the mirror.

questions.q: 4. A: Did anyone turn the TV on? B: No, I didn't. It turned on by [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Benda (it) menyala sendiri -> by itself.

questions.q: 5. We couldn't eat all the food [BLANK], so we gave some to the dog.
questions.explanation: Kami tidak bisa menghabiskannya sendiri -> ourselves.

questions.q: 6. Do it [BLANK], you've got plenty of time and the instruction book!
questions.explanation: Perintah kepada orang kedua: 'Do it yourself'.

exercises.title: Latihan 7: Membedakan Reflexive Pronoun dan Possessive Adjective
exercises.instruction: Ketik kata ganti refleksif (yourself, myself, herself, himself) atau kata sifat posesif (our, her, his, your) yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. When we go out in cold weather we put on [BLANK] coats.
questions.explanation: 'coats' adalah kata benda, memerlukan possessive adjective 'our'.

questions.q: 2. Mary always washes [BLANK] hands before eating.
questions.explanation: Mencuci tangan miliknya menggunakan possessive adjective 'her'.

questions.q: 3. You can burn [BLANK] if you touch it!
questions.explanation: Burn yourself (refleksif).

questions.q: 4. I often cut [BLANK] when I peel potatoes.
questions.explanation: Cut myself (refleksif).

questions.q: 5. Is Lucy enjoying [BLANK] at the beach party?
questions.explanation: Enjoy herself (refleksif).

questions.q: 6. Tom never cleans [BLANK] shoes!
questions.explanation: Sebelum kata benda 'shoes' gunakan possessive adjective 'his'.

questions.q: 7. Take off [BLANK] hats!
questions.explanation: Sebelum kata benda 'hats' gunakan 'your'.

questions.q: 8. Michael is always talking about [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Talk about himself (refleksif).

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Ketepatan Menggunakan Reflexive Pronoun Sesuai Aturan
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk yang benar apakah membutuhkan reflexive pronoun atau tidak.

questions.q: 1. John, don't be rude! Behave [BLANK] properly.
questions.explanation: Kata kerja 'behave' berpasangan dengan refleksif 'yourself'.

questions.q: 2. The children are amusing [BLANK] with the kitten.
questions.explanation: Amuse themselves.

questions.q: 3. Do your parents often get up [BLANK] early in the morning?
questions.hint: Get up tidak menggunakan kata ganti refleksif.
questions.explanation: 'get up' tidak membutuhkan reflexive pronoun.

questions.q: 4. They are doing their homework by [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Bentuk yang tepat adalah 'by themselves'.

questions.q: 5. My friend Brenda lives by [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Lives by herself.

questions.q: 6. The little girl hurt [BLANK] in the playground.
questions.explanation: Hurt herself.

questions.q: 7. I can do that [BLANK]!
questions.explanation: I can do that myself!

questions.q: 8. Tom, you must brush [BLANK] teeth three times a day.
questions.explanation: Gunakan kata sifat posesif 'your teeth'.

questions.q: 9. I can give you a lift; why don't we meet [BLANK] at 3 o'clock?
questions.hint: Kata kerja meet tidak memerlukan ourselves.
questions.explanation: 'meet' tidak membutuhkan reflexive pronoun.

questions.q: 10. He's always complaining [BLANK] about my cooking.
questions.explanation: 'complain' tidak memerlukan reflexive pronoun.

exercises.title: Latihan 9: Menulis Ulang Kalimat Menggunakan Reflexive Pronouns
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah kalimat penulisan ulang yang tepat memuat bentuk reflexive pronoun.

questions.q: 1. 'Jamie liked his new haircut and was looking at his hair in the mirror.' → Kalimat dengan reflexive pronoun:
options: Jamie liked his new haircut and was looking at himself in the mirror.
Jamie liked his new haircut and was looking at his in the mirror.
Jamie liked his new haircut and looked himself.
Jamie was looking at him in the mirror.
questions.answer: Jamie liked his new haircut and was looking at himself in the mirror.
questions.hint: Melihat dirinya sendiri di cermin = looking at himself in the mirror.
questions.explanation: Subjek Jamie melihat pantulan dirinya sendiri di cermin -> looking at himself in the mirror.

questions.q: 2. 'I accidentally burnt my finger on the iron.' → Kalimat dengan reflexive pronoun:
options: I accidentally burnt myself on the iron.
I accidentally burnt me on the iron.
I accidentally burnt my on the iron.
I burnt myself finger on the iron.
questions.answer: I accidentally burnt myself on the iron.
questions.hint: Saya tak sengaja melukai diri sendiri = burnt myself.
questions.explanation: Bentuk tepat: 'I accidentally burnt myself on the iron.'

questions.q: 3. 'Megan and I enjoyed it at Christine's barbecue.' → Kalimat dengan reflexive pronoun:
options: Megan and I enjoyed ourselves at Christine's barbecue.
Megan and I enjoyed themselves at Christine's barbecue.
Megan and I enjoyed us at Christine's barbecue.
Megan and I enjoyed our at Christine's barbecue.
questions.answer: Megan and I enjoyed ourselves at Christine's barbecue.
questions.hint: Megan and I = We -> enjoyed ourselves.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'Megan and I' setara dengan 'we', refleksifnya 'ourselves'.

questions.q: 4. 'The children behaved really well at school today.' → Kalimat dengan reflexive pronoun:
options: The children behaved themselves really well at school today.
The children behaved their really well at school today.
The children behaved them really well at school today.
The children behaved itself really well at school today.
questions.answer: The children behaved themselves really well at school today.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'behaved themselves'.

questions.q: 5. 'Julia painted her own bedroom at the weekend.' → Kalimat dengan reflexive pronoun:
options: Julia painted her bedroom herself at the weekend.
Julia painted her bedroom herself own at the weekend.
Julia painted her bedroom by him at the weekend.
Julia herself painted bedroom at the weekend.
questions.answer: Julia painted her bedroom herself at the weekend.
questions.hint: Julia mengecat sendiri = painted her bedroom herself.
questions.explanation: Bentuk tepat: 'Julia painted her bedroom herself at the weekend.'

questions.q: 6. 'Did you cut your own hair? It looks really nice.' → Kalimat dengan reflexive pronoun:
options: Did you cut your hair yourself? It looks really nice.
Did you cut you hair yourself? It looks really nice.
Did you cut yourself hair? It looks really nice.
Did you cut your hair you? It looks really nice.
questions.answer: Did you cut your hair yourself? It looks really nice.
questions.hint: Memotong rambutmu sendiri = cut your hair yourself.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'Did you cut your hair yourself?'.

grammar.summary: Kata kerja 'get' adalah salah satu kata kerja paling fleksibel dalam bahasa Inggris dengan berbagai makna: berubah keadaan (become), menerima/memperoleh (receive/obtain), dan tiba/sampai (arrive).

tables.title: Tiga Makna Utama 'to get'
rows: get tired, get dark, get old, get angry, get cold
get an email, get a present, get a job, get tickets
get home, get to school, get to the station

rules: Bentuk lampau dari 'get' adalah 'got', bentuk ketiga (past participle) adalah 'got' (UK) atau 'gotten' (US).
Frasa 'get home' TIDAK memakai 'to' (BUKAN get to home).
Phrasal verb umum: get up (bangun tidur), get on/off (naik/turun kendaraan umum), get out of (keluar).

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Bentuk to get + Adjective Sesuai Gambar
exercises.instruction: Ketik bentuk kata kerja to get + adjective (hungry, tired, angry, dressed, fat, lost, old, married) sesuai konteks gambar.

questions.q: 1. When I read a book, I always [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Get tired = menjadi lelah/mengantuk.

questions.q: 2. People like [BLANK] in famous churches.
questions.explanation: To get married = menikah.

questions.q: 3. When she doesn't study, her mother [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Subjek her mother (tunggal) -> gets angry.

questions.q: 4. Mark isn't ready, he [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Mark sedang memakai baju -> is getting dressed.

questions.q: 5. Don't eat so much fast food. You are [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Getting fat = bertambah gemuk.

questions.q: 6. Do you need directions? I don't want you to [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Get lost = tersesat.

questions.q: 7. I think my dog is [BLANK]. He doesn't like going for walks anymore.
questions.explanation: Getting old = semakin tua.

questions.q: 8. When I'm at work, I usually [BLANK] around 1 o'clock.
questions.explanation: Get hungry = merasa lapar.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Menjodohkan Respon Percakapan dengan to get (Audio TR 8)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan rekaman audio TR 8 dan jodohkan pernyataan A dengan respon B yang sesuai.

questions.q: 1. A: 'We're getting old.' → Respon B:
options: Why don't you take a break?
questions.hint: Audio TR 8: Tanggapan terhadap merasa tua.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 8: 'A: We're getting old. B: Oh, don't say that!'

questions.q: 2. A: 'It's getting busy in this café.' → Respon B:
options: Why don't you ask for help?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 8: 'A: It's getting busy in this café. B: Let's go outside.'

questions.q: 3. A: 'I'm getting bored of doing my homework.' → Respon B:
options: Why don't you take a break?
Why don't you put him to bed?
questions.answer: Why don't you take a break?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 8: 'A: I'm getting bored of doing my homework. B: Why don't you take a break?'

questions.q: 4. A: 'The baby's getting tired.' → Respon B:
options: Why don't you put him to bed?
Why doesn't he get it himself?
questions.answer: Why don't you put him to bed?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 8: 'A: The baby's getting tired. B: Why don't you put him to bed?'

questions.q: 5. A: 'I'm ready to go out.' → Respon B:
options: Why don't you ask for help?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 8: 'A: I'm ready to go out. B: Where are you going?'

questions.q: 6. A: 'This exercise is getting difficult.' → Respon B:
options: Why don't you ask for help?
Why don't you take a break?
questions.answer: Why don't you ask for help?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 8: 'A: This exercise is getting difficult. B: Why don't you ask for help?'

questions.q: 7. A: 'It's getting late.' → Respon B:
questions.explanation: Audio TR 8: 'A: It's getting late. B: Let's hurry up.'

questions.q: 8. A: 'I'm getting his jacket for him.' → Respon B:
options: Why doesn't he get it himself?
Why don't you put him to bed?
questions.answer: Why doesn't he get it himself?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 8: 'A: I'm getting his jacket for him. B: Why doesn't he get it himself?'

questions.q: 9. A: 'We got an email.' → Respon B:
options: Why don't you ask for help?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 8: 'A: We got an email. B: Who is it from?'

questions.q: 10. A: 'She got a dog for Christmas.' → Respon B:
options: Why doesn't he get it himself?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 8: 'A: She got a dog for Christmas. B: Who gave it to her?'

exercises.title: Latihan 3: Menyusun Kata Acak (Unscramble the Sentences with get)
exercises.instruction: Susun kata-kata acak berikut menjadi kalimat yang benar dengan get.

questions.q: 1. always / get / the employees / the year / at the / a bonus / end of → [BLANK]
questions.answer: The employees always get a bonus at the end of the year.
alternateAnswers: The employees always get a bonus at the end of the year
questions.hint: Karyawan selalu mendapat bonus di akhir tahun.
questions.explanation: Pola kalimat: The employees always get a bonus at the end of the year.

questions.q: 2. getting / I'm / with / programme / this / bored → [BLANK]
questions.answer: I'm getting bored with this programme.
alternateAnswers: I am getting bored with this programme.
I'm getting bored with this programme
questions.hint: Saya mulai bosan dengan acara ini.
questions.explanation: Pola kalimat: I'm getting bored with this programme.

questions.q: 3. a graphic designer / he / new / job / as / a / got → [BLANK]
questions.answer: He got a new job as a graphic designer.
alternateAnswers: He got a new job as a graphic designer
questions.hint: Dia mendapatkan pekerjaan baru sebagai desainer grafis.
questions.explanation: Pola kalimat: He got a new job as a graphic designer.

questions.q: 4. pass / can / you / please / magazine / me / that / ? → [BLANK]
questions.answer: Can you please pass me that magazine?
alternateAnswers: Can you pass me that magazine please?
Can you please pass me that magazine
questions.explanation: Pola pertanyaan: Can you please pass me that magazine?

questions.q: 5. the post office / get / I / to / the parcel / have / from → [BLANK]
questions.answer: I have to get the parcel from the post office.
alternateAnswers: I have to get the parcel from the post office
questions.hint: Saya harus mengambil paket dari kantor pos.
questions.explanation: Pola kalimat: I have to get the parcel from the post office.

questions.q: 6. dress / I / this / year / on / sale / got / last → [BLANK]
questions.answer: I got this dress on sale last year.
alternateAnswers: I got this dress on sale last year
questions.hint: Saya membeli gaun ini saat diskon tahun lalu.
questions.explanation: Pola kalimat: I got this dress on sale last year.

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Melengkapi Kalimat dengan get(s) + Frasa yang Tersedia
exercises.instruction: Ketik get atau gets disertai salah satu frasa: some stamps, tired, sick, money, me some water, that coat, some food, a suntan.

questions.q: 1. Can you [BLANK], please? I'm thirsty.
questions.explanation: Ambilkan air minum: 'get me some water'.

questions.q: 2. The fridge is empty. I must go to the store and [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Membeli makanan: 'get some food'.

questions.q: 3. I went to the bank to [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Mengambil uang: 'get some money'.

questions.q: 4. I hope to [BLANK] at the beach this summer.
questions.explanation: Menghitamkan kulit di pantai: 'get a suntan'.

questions.q: 5. Where did you [BLANK]? It's beautiful!
questions.explanation: Membeli mantel itu: 'get that coat'.

questions.q: 6. A: I'm going to the post office. B: Will you [BLANK] for me, please?
questions.explanation: Membeli prangko: 'get some stamps'.

questions.q: 7. She [BLANK] when she doesn't wear her scarf.
questions.explanation: Menjadi sakit: 'gets sick'.

questions.q: 8. We [BLANK] of waiting when they're late.
questions.explanation: Lelah menunggu: 'get tired'.

exercises.title: Latihan 5: Memilih Preposisi yang Tepat untuk Phrasal Verb get
exercises.instruction: Pilih preposisi yang tepat: up, in, out of, on, off, atau to.

questions.q: 1. Please get the dog [BLANK] the sofa, Max.
questions.explanation: Get off the sofa = turun dari atas sofa.

questions.q: 2. I always get [BLANK] at seven o'clock on weekdays.
questions.explanation: Get up = bangun tidur.

questions.q: 3. That loud noise really gets [BLANK] me. It's so annoying!
questions.hint: Gets to me = sangat mengganggu saya.
questions.explanation: Gets to someone = membuat kesal/jengkel.

questions.q: 4. The teacher asked us to get [BLANK] with some work quietly as she had to leave the classroom.
questions.hint: Get on with work = melanjutkan pekerjaan.
questions.explanation: Get on with = melanjutkan tugas.

questions.q: 5. Can we all get [BLANK] your mum's car and go to the town centre?
questions.explanation: Masuk mobil kecil menggunakan 'get in'.

questions.q: 6. The minute we got [BLANK] the house, it started to rain.
questions.explanation: Keluar dari ruangan/rumah: 'get out of'.

questions.q: 7. Get [BLANK] the train. It leaves in 5 minutes!
questions.hint: Naik ke dalam kereta api (kendaraan umum).
questions.explanation: Naik kereta/bus/pesawat menggunakan 'get on'.

questions.q: 8. I got [BLANK] a list on the Internet about the top 10 cities in the world.
questions.hint: Get up a list = membuka/memunculkan daftar di layar.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'up'.

questions.q: 9. I usually get [BLANK] the gym 20 minutes after I finish work.
questions.explanation: Get to = tiba di suatu tempat tujuan.

questions.q: 10. I got [BLANK] the Metro and walked to the restaurant.
questions.explanation: Turun dari angkutan umum: 'get off'.

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Menggunakan Bentuk to get + Kata Sifat
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk get + kata sifat yang tepat sesuai kalimat pengkondisian.

questions.q: 1. If you don't take your vitamins, you'll [BLANK].
questions.hint: Tidak minum vitamin bisa jatuh sakit.
questions.explanation: Get sick = jatuh sakit.

questions.q: 2. If you drink too much beer, you [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Get drunk = mabuk.

questions.q: 3. The film is boring at first but it [BLANK] at the end.
questions.hint: Filmnya menjadi menarik di bagian akhir.
questions.explanation: Gets interesting = menjadi menarik.

questions.q: 4. If you leave the window open in the winter, the room [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Gets cold = menjadi dingin.

questions.q: 5. If you stay up late every night, eventually you [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Get tired = menjadi lelah.

questions.q: 6. If you go out in the rain without an umbrella, you [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Get wet = menjadi basah kuyup.

questions.q: 7. You'll [BLANK] if you keep eating all that fried food.
questions.explanation: Get fat = bertambah gemuk.

questions.q: 8. Turn on the lights before it [BLANK] in here.
questions.explanation: Gets dark = menjadi gelap.

questions.q: 9. I can't come to your party because I'm sick. I'll call you when I [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Get better = pulih / sembuh.

questions.q: 10. If you stay out in the sun in the summer, you [BLANK].
questions.hint: Di bawah terik matahari musim panas.
questions.explanation: Get hot = kepanasan.

exercises.title: Latihan 7: Menentukan Makna Kata get dalam Kalimat
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah makna kata get pada kalimat: to receive, to obtain, to go and bring back, atau to buy / take.

questions.q: 1. 'Michael got full marks on his exams last month.' → Makna kata got:
questions.explanation: Mendapatkan capaian nilai = to obtain.

questions.q: 2. 'I got my brother's tennis racket out of his room.' → Makna got:
questions.hint: Pergi mengambil dan membawa keluar raket.
questions.explanation: To go and bring back = pergi mengambil barang lalu membawanya.

questions.q: 3. 'Sam and Francesca got their dog from an animal rescue centre.' → Makna got:
questions.explanation: To obtain = memperoleh.

questions.q: 4. 'Would you get some bread from the bakery?' → Makna get:
questions.explanation: To buy or to take = membeli roti.

questions.q: 5. 'I got these trousers for half price.' → Makna got:
questions.explanation: Membeli barang = to buy.

questions.q: 6. 'Did you get the key that was on the table?' → Makna get:
questions.explanation: To go and bring back = mengambil kunci.

questions.q: 7. 'Laura got five emails from her teacher while she was on holiday.' → Makna got:
questions.explanation: Menerima pesan masuk = to receive.

questions.q: 8. 'Could you get me my coat from the car, please?' → Makna get:
questions.hint: Tolong ambilkan mantel saya dari mobil.
questions.explanation: To go and bring back = mengambilkan mantel.

questions.q: 9. 'I got a new digital camera for my birthday.' → Makna got:
questions.explanation: Menerima hadiah = to receive.

questions.q: 10. 'I usually get a coffee from a café in the morning.' → Makna get:
questions.explanation: Membeli minuman = to buy.

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Melengkapi Phrasal Verbs dengan get (Audio TR 9)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan rekaman audio TR 9 dan ketik bentuk kata kerja get dan preposisi yang tepat (up, in, out of, on, off, to).

questions.q: 1. I was late for work because I didn't [BLANK] in time.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 9 nomor 1: '...because I didn't get up in time.'

questions.q: 2. Can we finish this tomorrow? I have to go to the station and [BLANK] my train at 8 o'clock.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 9 nomor 2: '...and get on my train at 8 o'clock.'

questions.q: 3. Maria was really upset. She just [BLANK] her car and drove away.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 9 nomor 3: 'She just got in her car and drove away.'

questions.q: 4. Kim didn't [BLANK] class until 5 o'clock.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 9 nomor 4: 'Kim didn't get out of class until 5 o'clock.'

questions.q: 5. How do you [BLANK] with your work colleagues?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 9 nomor 5: 'How do you get on with your work colleagues?'

questions.q: 6. We won't [BLANK] the party on time if you don't hurry up.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 9 nomor 6: 'We won't get to the party on time...'

questions.q: 7. This is the last stop. Everyone must [BLANK] the bus.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 9 nomor 7: 'Everyone must get off the bus.'

questions.q: 8. The thieves [BLANK] with thousands of pounds and some jewellery.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 9 nomor 8: 'The thieves got off with thousands of pounds...'

questions.q: 9. The teacher asked them to [BLANK] with their work.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 9 nomor 9: 'The teacher asked them to get on with their work.'

questions.q: 10. Sorry. I didn't mean to [BLANK] you in trouble.
questions.hint: Get you in trouble = membuatmu terkena masalah
questions.explanation: Audio TR 9 nomor 10: '...didn't mean to get you in trouble.'

exercises.title: Latihan 9: Melengkapi Ungkapan Phrasal Verb get
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk frasa get yang paling tepat untuk melengkapi kalimat berikut.

questions.q: 1. Every morning I [BLANK] early to prepare for school.
questions.explanation: Get up early = bangun pagi.

questions.q: 2. The thing that really [BLANK] my nerves is when people are noisy.
questions.hint: Gets on my nerves = membuat jengkel.
questions.explanation: Get on one's nerves = menjengkelkan.

questions.q: 3. The minute I [BLANK] the house this morning, it started raining.
questions.explanation: Got out of the house = keluar dari rumah.

questions.q: 4. Last week when I [BLANK] the metro, I met an old friend.
questions.explanation: Got off the metro = turun dari metro.

questions.q: 5. I often [BLANK] the sports club half an hour after I finish school.
questions.explanation: Get to = tiba di tempat.

questions.q: 6. One of the things that can [BLANK] me in a bad mood is traffic jams.
questions.hint: Get me in a bad mood = membuat suasana hati buruk.
questions.explanation: Get me in a bad mood.

units.title: could (Kemampuan Masa Lalu & Kesopanan)
units.english_title: could: Past Ability, Polite Requests, Possibility

grammar.summary: 'Could' digunakan untuk menyatakan kemampuan umum di masa lampau, meminta bantuan dengan santun, atau menyatakan kemungkinan.

tables.title: Fungsi could
rows: I could swim when I was six.
Could you help me with this box?
Could I use your phone, please?
It could be very hot tomorrow.

rules: Bentuk negatif dari could adalah couldn't (could not).
Selalu diikuti kata kerja bentuk pertama tanpa 'to'.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Menyusun Kata Menjadi Permintaan Sopan (could)
exercises.instruction: Susun kata-kata acak berikut menjadi kalimat permintaan sopan menggunakan could.

questions.q: 1. borrow / could / sugar / I / some → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Pola permohonan izin: Could I borrow some sugar?

questions.q: 2. you / children / could / the / watch → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Pola permohonan sopan: Could you watch the children?

questions.q: 3. the / lock / could / you / door → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Pola: Could you lock the door?

questions.q: 4. tell / you / excuse / time / me / could / me / the → [BLANK]
questions.answer: Excuse me, could you tell me the time?
alternateAnswers: Excuse me could you tell me the time?
Excuse me, could you tell me the time
questions.hint: Permisi, bisakah Anda memberi tahu jam berapa sekarang?
questions.explanation: Pola: Excuse me, could you tell me the time?

questions.q: 5. move / you / this / could / table / me / help → [BLANK]
questions.answer: Could you help me move this table?
alternateAnswers: Could you help me move this table
could you help me move this table?
questions.hint: Bisakah Anda membantu saya memindahkan meja ini?
questions.explanation: Pola: Could you help me move this table?

questions.q: 6. carton / could / me / of / you / milk / get / a → [BLANK]
questions.answer: Could you get me a carton of milk?
alternateAnswers: Could you get me a carton of milk
could you get me a carton of milk?
questions.explanation: Pola: Could you get me a carton of milk?

questions.q: 7. number / you / me / could / phone / your / give → [BLANK]
questions.answer: Could you give me your phone number?
alternateAnswers: Could you give me your phone number
could you give me your phone number?
questions.hint: Bisakah Anda memberikan nomor telepon Anda?
questions.explanation: Pola: Could you give me your phone number?

questions.q: 8. the / me / you / for / could / open / door → [BLANK]
questions.answer: Could you open the door for me?
alternateAnswers: Could you open the door for me
could you open the door for me?
questions.hint: Bisakah Anda membukakan pintu untuk saya?
questions.explanation: Pola: Could you open the door for me?

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Merumuskan Kalimat Permintaan Berdasarkan Situasi
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah kalimat permintaan sopan menggunakan could yang paling tepat sesuai situasi.

questions.q: 1. Situasi: You're hot and the window is closed. → Permintaan yang tepat:
options: Could you open the window, please?
Could you close the window, please?
questions.answer: Could you open the window, please?
questions.explanation: Meminta membuka jendela: 'Could you open the window, please?'

questions.q: 2. Situasi: You need help carrying your suitcase. → Permintaan yang tepat:
options: Could you help me carry my suitcase, please?
questions.answer: Could you help me carry my suitcase, please?
questions.explanation: Meminta tolong membawa koper: 'Could you help me carry my suitcase, please?'

questions.q: 3. Situasi: You are at the train station and want to catch a train to Dublin, but don't know the departure time. → Permintaan:
options: Could you tell me what time the train to Dublin leaves?
Could you drive me to Dublin?
Could I buy a car to Dublin?
Could you stop the Dublin train?
questions.answer: Could you tell me what time the train to Dublin leaves?
questions.hint: Menanyakan jadwal keberangkatan kereta ke Dublin.
questions.explanation: Gunakan: 'Could you tell me what time the train to Dublin leaves?'

questions.q: 4. Situasi: You forgot your watch and you need to know the time. → Permintaan:
options: Could you tell me the time, please?
Could you lend me your watch forever?
Could you tell me where the station is?
questions.answer: Could you tell me the time, please?
questions.hint: Lupa jam tangan dan ingin tahu waktu.
questions.explanation: Gunakan: 'Could you tell me the time, please?'

questions.q: 5. Situasi: You forgot your wallet at home. → Permintaan:
options: Could you lend me some money, please?
Could you buy a new wallet for me?
Could you pay all my bills?
questions.answer: Could you lend me some money, please?
questions.explanation: Meminjam uang: 'Could you lend me some money, please?'

questions.q: 6. Situasi: The children are screaming and you want to rest. → Permintaan:
questions.hint: Anak-anak berteriak dan Anda ingin istirahat.
questions.explanation: Meminta tenang: 'Could you please be quiet?'

questions.q: 7. Situasi: You receive a phone call but you can't talk right now. → Permintaan:
options: Could I call you back later?
Could I never talk to you?
questions.answer: Could I call you back later?
questions.hint: Tidak bisa bicara sekarang, menelpon kembali nanti.
questions.explanation: Menelpon balik: 'Could I call you back later?'

questions.q: 8. Situasi: You are doing maths homework and need help with an exercise. → Permintaan:
options: Could you help me with this exercise, please?
Could you do all my exams?
Could I give you my homework?
questions.answer: Could you help me with this exercise, please?
questions.explanation: Meminta bantuan belajar: 'Could you help me with this exercise, please?'

exercises.title: Latihan 3: Percakapan Telepon Meminta Bantuan (Audio TR 10)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan rekaman audio TR 10 dan lengkapi bagian rumpang percakapan telepon.

questions.q: 1. Dialog 1 - Terry: 'Hi, Diane. (1) [BLANK] at school today?'
questions.explanation: Audio TR 10: 'Why weren't you at school today?'

questions.q: 2. Dialog 1 - Diane: 'I'm (2) [BLANK]. I have the flu. (3) [BLANK2] if we have any homework for next week?'
questions.hint: Sakit flu dan bertanya tentang PR.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 10: 'I'm sick. I have the flu. Could you tell me if we have any homework...?'

questions.q: 3. Dialog 1 - Terry: 'Yes, (4) [BLANK] going to be a Maths test on Tuesday...'
questions.explanation: Audio TR 10: '...there's going to be a Maths test on Tuesday...'

questions.q: 4. Dialog 1 - Terry: 'No. But I hope (5) [BLANK] soon.'
questions.explanation: Audio TR 10: '...I hope you get better soon.'

questions.q: 5. Dialog 2 - Jack: 'Yes, I didn't have any (1) [BLANK] this afternoon at university.'
questions.explanation: Audio TR 10: '...didn't have any lectures this afternoon at university.'

questions.q: 6. Dialog 2 - Anne: '(2) [BLANK] you do me a favour, please? My car (3) [BLANK2] in the garage.'
questions.hint: Bolehkah minta tolong? Mobil sedang diperbaiki di bengkel.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 10: 'Could you do me a favour, please?... my car is being fixed in the garage.'

questions.q: 7. Dialog 2 - Anne: 'Could you (4) [BLANK] me to class? It's from 7:30 p.m. to 9:30 p.m.'
questions.explanation: Audio TR 10: 'Could you drive me to class?'

questions.q: 8. Dialog 2 - Anne: 'I have some (5) [BLANK] to finish this afternoon, so could we leave here at around 7 p.m.?'
questions.explanation: Audio TR 10: 'Well, I have some coursework to finish this afternoon...'

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Pemahaman Informasi Percakapan Telepon
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah jawaban yang benar berdasarkan percakapan audio TR 10 antara Anne dan Jack.

questions.q: 1. What does Anne ask Jack?
options: To drive her to her evening English class.
To fix her car in the garage.
To lend her some money for university.
To do her coursework for her.
questions.answer: To drive her to her evening English class.
questions.hint: Anne meminta diantar ke kelas bahasa Inggris.
questions.explanation: Anne bertanya: 'Could you drive me to class?' karena mobilnya sedang di bengkel.

questions.q: 2. Is Jack happy to do Anne a favour?
options: He refuses because of his lectures.
He asks Anne to pay for petrol.
questions.explanation: Jack langsung merespon: 'Yes, of course! What time's your class?'

questions.q: 3. What does Anne have to do in the afternoon before her class?
options: Go shopping in the town centre.
questions.explanation: Anne mengatakan: 'I have some coursework to finish this afternoon'.

questions.q: 4. Does Jack need to bring Anne back home in the car after class?
options: No, because she is going out to eat with classmates.
No, she is taking a taxi.
questions.answer: No, because she is going out to eat with classmates.
questions.hint: Anne akan makan bersama teman sekelasnya.
questions.explanation: Anne berkata: 'No, that's fine. A few classmates and I are going to get something to eat after the class.'

questions.q: 5. What time is Anne's class?
questions.explanation: Anne mengatakan: 'It's from 7:30 p.m. to 9:30 p.m.'

questions.q: 6. What does Jack tell Anne to do when she is ready to leave?
options: Wait in front of the house.
questions.explanation: Jack berkata: 'Well, knock on my room door when you're ready to leave.'

exercises.title: Latihan 5: Memberikan Saran Menggunakan could
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah saran yang tepat menggunakan could untuk mengatasi permasalahan berikut.

questions.q: 1. Cara: 'I always get up late and miss the bus to college.' → Saran yang tepat:
options: I think Cara could set an alarm clock to wake her up early.
She could stop going to college.
She could walk 20 miles to college.
She could stay awake all night.
questions.answer: I think Cara could set an alarm clock to wake her up early.
questions.hint: Menyetel jam beker agar bangun pagi.
questions.explanation: Contoh buku: 'I think Cara could set an alarm clock to wake her up early.'

questions.q: 2. Ben: 'I keep losing my keys in my house.' → Saran:
options: You could put a key bowl near the front door to keep them in one place.
You could never lock your house door.
You could throw away all your keys.
You could buy ten new houses.
questions.answer: You could put a key bowl near the front door to keep them in one place.
questions.hint: Menaruh mangkuk kunci dekat pintu depan.
questions.explanation: Saran praktis: 'You could put a key bowl near the front door.'

questions.q: 3. Marco: 'My brother wants to get fit but he hates the gym.' → Saran:
options: He could take up running or cycling outdoors.
He could eat fast food every day.
He could sleep 15 hours a day.
questions.answer: He could take up running or cycling outdoors.
questions.hint: Berolahraga di luar ruangan seperti lari atau sepeda.
questions.explanation: Saran: 'He could take up running or cycling outdoors.'

questions.q: 4. Luke: 'I'm new in my neighbourhood and haven't got any friends yet.' → Saran:
options: You could join a local sports club or community centre.
You could stay inside your room forever.
You could move to another country immediately.
You could ignore all your neighbours.
questions.answer: You could join a local sports club or community centre.
questions.hint: Bergabung dengan klub olahraga atau kegiatan warga.
questions.explanation: Saran: 'You could join a local sports club or community centre.'

questions.q: 5. Georgia: 'My essay is due in next week, but I'm stuck and I need help.' → Saran:
options: You could ask your teacher or tutor for guidance.
You could copy an essay from the internet.
You could miss the submission deadline.
questions.answer: You could ask your teacher or tutor for guidance.
questions.explanation: Saran: 'You could ask your teacher or tutor for guidance.'

questions.q: 6. Aaron: 'I really liked a song I heard on the radio, but I don't know what it is called.' → Saran:
options: You could use a music recognition app or search the lyrics online.
You could never listen to music again.
You could buy the whole radio station.
questions.answer: You could use a music recognition app or search the lyrics online.
questions.hint: Mencari lirik lagu atau memakai aplikasi pengenal musik.
questions.explanation: Saran: 'You could use a music recognition app or search the lyrics online.'

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Menanyakan Arah Jalan di Chicago (Audio TR 11)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan rekaman percakapan audio TR 11 saat Ursula tersesat di Chicago, lalu pilih jawaban yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. Where does Ursula want to go?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 11: Ursula mengatakan: 'I'm looking for the Central Train Station...'

questions.q: 2. Who does Ursula ask for help?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 11: 'Excuse me, officer, could you help me?'

questions.q: 3. Is Ursula walking in the right direction?
options: Yes, she is in the right direction.
No, she is completely in the opposite direction.
questions.answer: Yes, she is in the right direction.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 11: Polisi menjawab: 'Well, you're in the right direction.'

questions.q: 4. Why does Ursula decide not to walk?
options: Because her suitcase is very heavy.
questions.answer: Because her suitcase is very heavy.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 11: 'Ah, my suitcase is so heavy. Is there a bus that stops there?'

questions.q: 5. What bus stops in front of the train station?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 11: Polisi mengatakan: 'Yes, there is. Bus H stops in front of the train station.'

questions.q: 6. Where can Ursula buy a bus ticket?
options: At the newsstand across the street.
questions.answer: At the newsstand across the street.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 11: 'You can buy a ticket at the newsstand across the street.'

questions.q: 7. How long will the trip take by bus?
questions.hint: Hanya sekitar 6 menit karena jalanan lancar.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 11: 'Well, there's no traffic at this hour. It'll take about six minutes.'

questions.q: 8. How will Ursula know when to get off the bus?
options: The Central Station is very big; she can't miss it.
The bus driver will wake her up.
She has to look for a small sign.
The policeman will ride with her.
questions.answer: The Central Station is very big; she can't miss it.
questions.hint: Stasiunnya sangat besar sehingga mudah terlihat.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 11: '...don't worry; the Central Station is very big. You can't miss it!'

exercises.title: Latihan 7: Respon Permintaan Situasional yang Tepat (Audio TR 12)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan situasi pada audio TR 12 dan pilih ungkapan permintaan yang paling tepat (a atau b).

questions.q: 1. Situasi 1: You're hot and all the windows on the train are closed.
options: Could I open the window, please?
Could I shut the window, please?
questions.answer: Could I open the window, please?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 12 nomor 1: 'Could I open the window, please?'

questions.q: 2. Situasi 2: You're a tourist and need information on how to get to the train station.
options: Could you tell me the way to the train station, please?
Could you tell me what time the train leaves, please?
questions.answer: Could you tell me the way to the train station, please?
questions.explanation: Audio TR 12 nomor 2: 'Could you tell me the way to the train station, please?'

questions.q: 3. Situasi 3: You see a pair of jeans you like but don't know if they fit you.
options: Could I try them on, please?
questions.answer: Could I try them on, please?
questions.hint: Mencoba celana jeans di ruang pas.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 12 nomor 3: 'Could I try them on, please?'

questions.q: 4. Situasi 4: You see an old lady trying to cross the street.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 12 nomor 4: 'Could I help you cross?'

questions.q: 5. Situasi 5: You forgot your watch and the bus isn't arriving. What do you ask?
options: Could you tell me the time, please?
Could you arrive on time, please?
questions.answer: Could you tell me the time, please?
questions.hint: Menanyakan jam kepada orang di sebelah halte.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 12 nomor 5: 'Could you tell me the time, please?'

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Percakapan Menawarkan Bantuan Kepada Saudara (could)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah kalimat yang tepat untuk menyusun percakapan menawarkan bantuan pindahan rumah kepada sepupu Anda.

questions.q: 1. Kalimat pembuka menawarkan bantuan pindahan:
options: Hi! Could I help you unpack some boxes?
Could you pay me for visiting?
Could you leave your boxes outside?
questions.answer: Hi! Could I help you unpack some boxes?
questions.explanation: Ungkapan sopan menawarkan bantuan: 'Could I help you unpack some boxes?'

questions.q: 2. Tanggapan sepupu menerima bantuan:
options: That would be wonderful, thanks! Could you carry this box into the bedroom?
questions.answer: That would be wonderful, thanks! Could you carry this box into the bedroom?
questions.explanation: Respon sopan: 'That would be wonderful, thanks! Could you carry this box...?'

questions.q: 3. Menanyakan hal lain yang bisa dibantu:
options: Could I help you assemble the furniture too?
Could you buy me lunch right now?
questions.answer: Could I help you assemble the furniture too?
questions.explanation: 'Could I help you assemble the furniture too?'

questions.q: 4. Mengusulkan istirahat dan makan bersama:
options: When we finish, could we get something to eat at the new café?
You must cook dinner for me now.
Could you give me your house?
questions.answer: When we finish, could we get something to eat at the new café?
questions.explanation: Saran sopan: 'When we finish, could we get something to eat...?'

grammar.summary: Kata penentu jumlah (quantifiers) yang digunakan bersama kata benda dapat dihitung (countable) maupun tidak dapat dihitung (uncountable).

tables.title: Aturan some, any, no, every
rows: I have some apples. Would you like some tea?
I don't have any money. Do you have any pens?
Bermakna negatif tapi dengan kata kerja positif (+)
There are no chairs in the room.

rules: Jangan gunakan 'no' bersama kalimat yang sudah ada 'not' (Double negative salah: BUKAN 'I don't have no time').
'Every' selalu diikuti kata benda tunggal: 'every student', bukan 'every students'.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Lengkapi dengan some, any, no, atau every
exercises.instruction: Ketik kata some, any, no, atau every yang tepat untuk melengkapi kalimat.

questions.q: 1. We've got [BLANK] lemons but we haven't got [BLANK2] bread.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'some' untuk kalimat positif dan 'any' untuk kalimat negatif.

questions.q: 2. I don't have [BLANK] clean socks to wear!
questions.explanation: Kalimat negatif menggunakan 'any'.

questions.q: 3. There were [BLANK] people from my school at the party. Five or six girls.
questions.explanation: Kalimat positif menyatakan beberapa: 'some'.

questions.q: 4. Can I have [BLANK] biscuits, please?
questions.explanation: Permintaan sopan yang mengharapkan jawaban ya memakai 'some'.

questions.q: 5. I take a shower [BLANK] morning.
questions.explanation: Rutinitas sehari-hari menggunakan 'every morning'.

questions.q: 6. [BLANK] time he calls, he complains.
questions.explanation: 'Every time' bermakna setiap kali.

questions.q: 7. I don't have [BLANK] homework today.
questions.explanation: Kalimat negatif menggunakan 'any'.

questions.q: 8. Would you like [BLANK] milk in your coffee?
questions.explanation: Tawaran sopan (offer) menggunakan 'some'.

questions.q: 9. When he moved to New York, he had [BLANK] place to stay. He slept at the station!
questions.hint: Sama sekali tidak memiliki tempat tinggal.
questions.explanation: Bentuk penegasan negatif tanpa not: 'had no place to stay'.

questions.q: 10. I play tennis [BLANK] Saturday.
questions.explanation: 'Every Saturday' menyatakan jadwal rutin.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Deskripsi Gambar Menggunakan some atau any
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah kalimat deskripsi gambar yang benar menggunakan kata benda dan some / any.

questions.q: 1. Gambar 1 (Toples bertuliskan 'SUGAR' kosong melompong) → Deskripsi yang tepat:
options: The woman doesn't have any sugar.
The woman has got some sugar.
The woman doesn't have some sugar.
questions.answer: The woman doesn't have any sugar.
questions.explanation: Kalimat negatif: 'The woman doesn't have any sugar.'

questions.q: 2. Gambar 2 (Sapi, domba, dan kuda di padang rumput) → Deskripsi yang tepat:
options: There are some animals in the field.
There aren't any animals in the field.
There is some sugar in the field.
questions.answer: There are some animals in the field.
questions.hint: Ada beberapa hewan di padang rumput.
questions.explanation: Kalimat positif jamak: 'There are some animals in the field.'

questions.q: 3. Gambar 3 (Mobil van bermuatan kursi, meja, dan lemari) → Deskripsi yang tepat:
options: The van has got some furniture.
The van doesn't have any furniture.
There is some animals in the van.
questions.answer: The van has got some furniture.
questions.explanation: Furniture uncountable memakai 'some furniture'.

questions.q: 4. Gambar 4 (Jalan raya dengan dua mobil) → Deskripsi yang tepat:
options: There is some traffic on the road.
There is no cars on the road.
questions.answer: There is some traffic on the road.
questions.hint: Ada lalu lintas kendaraan di jalan.
questions.explanation: 'There is some traffic on the road.'

questions.q: 5. Gambar 5 (Mangkuk berisi buah persik/buah-buahan) → Deskripsi yang tepat:
options: There are some peaches in the bowl.
There isn't any peaches in the bowl.
There are any peaches in the bowl.
There is some sugar in the bowl.
questions.answer: There are some peaches in the bowl.
questions.explanation: Pola kalimat afirmatif: 'There are some peaches in the bowl.'

questions.q: 6. Gambar 6 (Kios majalah penuh pajangan) → Deskripsi yang tepat:
options: There are some magazines in the shop.
There aren't any magazines in the shop.
questions.answer: There are some magazines in the shop.
questions.explanation: 'There are some magazines in the shop.'

exercises.title: Latihan 3: Mengubah Kalimat Antara not any dan no
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah kalimat hasil pengubahan antara pola not ... any dan no yang benar.

questions.q: 1. 'I haven't got any friends.' → Bentuk dengan 'no':
questions.hint: haven't got any = have got no.
questions.explanation: Contoh buku: 'I've got no friends.'

questions.q: 2. 'I have no coins.' → Bentuk dengan 'not any':
questions.explanation: Contoh buku: 'I haven't got any coins.'

questions.q: 3. 'I've got no cats or dogs.' → Bentuk dengan 'not any':

units.english_title: Compound Words of some, any, no, every

grammar.summary: Penggabungan kata some, any, no, every dengan -one/-body (orang), -thing (benda), dan -where (tempat).
rules: Kata majemuk ini SELALU diperlakukan sebagai subjek tunggal (singular verb): 'Everybody is ready' (BUKAN 'are').
Gunakan no- untuk kalimat positif bermakna negatif: 'Nobody called me today.'
Gunakan any- untuk kalimat tanya atau kalimat negatif: 'Did anyone see my keys?'

grammar.summary: 'have to' menyatakan kewajiban/keharusan dari pihak luar (aturan, hukum, jadwal). 'don't have to' menyatakan tidak adanya keharusan (tidak wajib/bebas).
rules: 'don't have to' BUKAN berarti larangan (prohibition), melainkan 'kamu tidak perlu/bebas memilih'.
Untuk larangan mutlak, gunakan 'mustn't' atau 'cannot'.
Bentuk lampau dari have to / has to adalah 'had to': 'I had to go to the doctor yesterday.'

questions.explanation: Keharusan untuk subjek orang ketiga tunggal (Maria): 'has to pass'.

options: ...so I have to stay in bed for a few days.

questions.explanation: Audio TR 14: 'I've got a cold so I have to stay in bed for a few days.'

exercises.title: Latihan 7: Aturan di Tempat Kerja (have to / don't have to)
exercises.instruction: Baca kalimat mengenai aturan kerja, lalu lengkapi dengan have to atau don't have to.

questions.q: 1. Maxine: We [BLANK] be on time everyday at work.
questions.explanation: Aturan kantor mewajibkan tepat waktu: 'We have to be on time everyday at work.'

questions.q: 2. Rick: At my work, we [BLANK] bring our own food for lunch because there is a canteen.
questions.explanation: Karena ada kantin, membawa bekal makanan sendiri bukan keharusan: 'don't have to bring our own food'.

questions.q: 3. Kim: My boss says that we [BLANK] log-on to our computers by 9 a.m.

questions.q: 4. Maryanne: I work in a hospital, so I [BLANK] wash my hands before helping a patient.
questions.explanation: Prosedur medis mengharuskan cuci tangan: 'I have to wash my hands before helping a patient.'

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Aturan Umum di Rumah, Sekolah, dan Masyarakat
exercises.instruction: Lengkapi pernyataan aturan umum dengan have to atau don't have to sesuai kewajiban yang berlaku.

questions.q: 1. In Britain, drivers [BLANK] drive on the left side of the road.

questions.explanation: Keselamatan penerbangan: 'passengers have to fasten their seatbelts'.

questions.explanation: Kewajiban paspor: 'you have to show your passport'.

questions.q: 6. You [BLANK] pay to enter a public park; admission is completely free for everyone.
questions.explanation: Karena gratis, Anda tidak perlu membayar: 'you don't have to pay'.

units.title: should, shall, ought to atau shouldn't

grammar.summary: 'should' dan 'ought to' digunakan untuk memberikan saran atau anjuran. 'shouldn't' digunakan untuk menyarankan agar tidak melakukan sesuatu. 'shall' digunakan untuk menawarkan bantuan atau mengajak.

tables.title: Ringkasan Modal Saran
rows: You shouldn't eat too much candy.
Shall I carry that bag for you?

rules: 'should' dan 'shouldn't' langsung diikuti V1 tanpa to.
'ought to' selalu menggunakan 'to' sebelum kata kerja: 'You ought to apologize.'
'shall' dalam bahasa Inggris modern paling umum dipakai dalam kalimat tanya dengan subjek 'I' atau 'we'.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Memberi Nasihat dengan should (Audio TR 16)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan keluhan masalah sehari-hari pada audio TR 16, lalu pilih saran yang tepat menggunakan should.

questions.q: 2. Dialog 2: Apa nasihat dokter mengenai pola makan Mr. Kane yang menyukai burger dan pizza?

questions.q: 4. Dialog 3: Apa saran Dr. Jefferson kepada Janet?

You should move to another house.

grammar.summary: Present Perfect (have/has + Past Participle V3) menghubungkan masa lalu dengan masa sekarang. Digunakan untuk pengalaman hidup (ever/never), peristiwa baru saja terjadi (just/already/yet), serta perubahan/hasil yang dirasakan sekarang.

tables.title: Perbedaan been to vs gone to
rows: Pernah ke sana dan sudah kembali pulang
Pergi ke sana dan belum pulang
Sekarang masih berada di tempat tujuan.

rules: Gunakan 'ever' dalam kalimat tanya: 'Have you ever been to Bali?'
Gunakan 'never' untuk kalimat positif bermakna belum pernah: 'I have never eaten sushi.'
'yet' digunakan di akhir kalimat negatif dan kalimat tanya: 'I haven't finished yet.'

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Bentuk Past Participle (V3) untuk Present Perfect
exercises.instruction: Ketik bentuk kata kerja ketiga (Past Participle / V3) dari kata kerja dasar berikut.

questions.q: 1. be → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'be' adalah 'been'.

questions.q: 2. see → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'see' adalah 'seen'.

questions.q: 3. eat → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'eat' adalah 'eaten'.

questions.q: 4. write → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'write' adalah 'written' (dengan double t).

questions.q: 5. do → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'do' adalah 'done'.

questions.q: 6. go → [BLANK]

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Pengalaman Wisata Emily & Jessica (Audio TR 18)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan percakapan pengalaman perjalanan pada audio TR 18, lalu tentukan pernyataan yang benar.

questions.q: 1. Kota manakah di Amerika Serikat yang pernah dikunjungi oleh Jessica?
questions.hint: I've been to New York and Washington.
questions.explanation: Jessica menyatakan: 'I've been to New York and Washington.'

questions.q: 2. Apakah Jessica pernah pergi ke San Francisco atau Los Angeles?
options: Belum pernah sama sekali (never been there).
Pernah satu kali dua tahun lalu.
questions.answer: Belum pernah sama sekali (never been there).
questions.hint: never been to San Francisco or Los Angeles
questions.explanation: Jessica mengatakan: 'I've never been to San Francisco or Los Angeles.'

questions.q: 3. Siapakah yang pernah mengunjungi Irlandia (Ireland)?

questions.answer: Emily pernah ke sana beberapa tahun yang lalu.

exercises.instruction: Lengkapi kalimat tanya Present Perfect berikut sesuai rekaman TR 19.

questions.q: 1. [BLANK] you heard the news?
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan untuk subjek 'you': 'Have you heard the news?'

questions.q: 2. [BLANK] your father left for work yet?
questions.hint: Your father adalah orang ketiga tunggal (he)
questions.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'your father' memakai kata bantu 'Has'.

questions.q: 3. Have you had dinner [BLANK]?
questions.explanation: Kata 'yet' digunakan di akhir kalimat tanya atau negatif untuk menanyakan keterlaksanaan.

questions.q: 4. How long have you [BLANK] (know) him?
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'know' adalah 'known'.

questions.q: 5. Have you [BLANK] seen this programme before?
questions.explanation: 'ever' bermakna pernah dalam kalimat tanya Present Perfect.

grammar.summary: Digunakan untuk menyatakan kegiatan yang telah dimulai di masa lalu dan masih terus berlangsung hingga saat ini, atau baru saja berhenti dengan bukti yang jelas saat ini.

tables.title: Rumus Present Perfect Continuous
rows: It has been raining for two hours.
I haven't been sleeping well lately.
How long + have/has + Subject + been + V-ing?
How long have you been studying English?

tables.title: Perbedaan for vs since
rows: for two hours, for three days, for ten years
since 8 a.m., since Monday, since 2015, since yesterday

rules: Pertanyaan mengenai durasi kegiatan menggunakan 'How long have you been...?'
Kata kerja statis (state verbs seperti know, like, believe) umumnya menggunakan Present Perfect Simple, bukan Continuous.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Bentuk Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + V-ing)
exercises.instruction: Ketik bentuk Present Perfect Continuous yang benar (have been / has been + kata kerja berakhiran -ing).

questions.q: 1. It [BLANK] (rain) heavily for three hours.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'It' menggunakan 'has been raining' untuk aktivitas yang berlangsung terus-menerus.

questions.q: 2. They [BLANK] (wait) for the delayed bus since 8 o'clock.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'They' menggunakan 'have been waiting'.

questions.q: 3. She [BLANK] (study) English at this academy for two years.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'She' menggunakan 'has been studying'.

questions.q: 4. I [BLANK] (learn) how to code software recently.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'I' menggunakan 'have been learning'.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Penggunaan for vs since
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah 'for' (periode durasi waktu) atau 'since' (titik awal waktu) yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. We have been living in this city [BLANK] 2018.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'since' sebelum tahun atau titik awal waktu.

questions.q: 2. He has been playing football [BLANK] two hours.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'for' sebelum durasi atau rentang waktu.

questions.q: 3. I haven't seen Sarah [BLANK] last Monday.
questions.explanation: Titik waktu tertentu memakai 'since'.

questions.q: 4. They have been working on the project [BLANK] six months.
questions.explanation: Rentang durasi memakai 'for'.

units.title: Klausa penghubung (Relative Clauses)
units.english_title: Relative Clauses: who, which, that, where, whose

grammar.summary: Klausa penghubung memberikan informasi tambahan tentang orang, benda, kepemilikan, atau tempat tanpa harus membuat kalimat baru.

tables.title: Kata Ganti Relatif (Relative Pronouns)
rows: The girl who won the race is my sister.
The book which is on the table is mine.
The laptop that I bought is fast.
This is the restaurant where we had dinner.
I met a boy whose father is an astronaut.

rules: 'who' menggantikan he/she/they.
'whose' menggantikan his/her/their untuk kepemilikan.
'where' menggantikan there / at that place.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Kata Ganti Penghubung (who, which, where, whose)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah relative pronoun yang tepat untuk melengkapi klausa penjelas.

questions.q: 1. That is the architect [BLANK] designed our school library.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'who' untuk merujuk pada orang.

questions.q: 2. Here is the laptop [BLANK] I bought last week.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'which' atau 'that' untuk benda.

questions.q: 3. This is the town [BLANK] William Shakespeare was born.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'where' untuk merujuk pada tempat terjadinya sesuatu.

questions.q: 4. I met a boy [BLANK] brother is a famous singer.
questions.hint: Kepemilikan saudara laki-laki dari anak itu
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'whose' untuk menyatakan hubungan kepemilikan.

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Pemahaman Klausa Relatif (Audio TR 20)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan rekaman audio TR 20 dan lengkapi klausa relatif yang diucapkan.

questions.q: 1. The eggs [BLANK] I bought yesterday are bad.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 20 nomor 1: 'The eggs which I bought yesterday are bad.'

questions.q: 2. The boy [BLANK] broke the window will be punished.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 20 nomor 2: 'The boy who broke the window will be punished.'

questions.q: 3. The hairdresser [BLANK] cut your hair did a good job.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 20 nomor 3: 'The hairdresser who cut your hair did a good job.'

questions.q: 4. This is the shop [BLANK] I go to buy my clothes.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 20 nomor 5: 'This is the shop where I go to buy my clothes.'

units.title: Kata kerja + infinitif; kata kerja + ing

grammar.summary: Ketika dua kata kerja berdampingan, kata kerja kedua bisa berbentuk to-infinitive (to do) atau gerund (-ing) tergantung kata kerja utamanya.

tables.title: Daftar Kata Kerja dan Polanya
rows: want, hope, decide, plan, promise, learn, offer
enjoy, mind, avoid, finish, practice, imagine
good at, interested in, keen on, tired of

rules: Setelah kata depan (preposisi: at, in, of, about, etc.), kata kerja SELALU berakhiran -ing.
Beberapa kata kerja seperti like, love, hate dapat diikuti keduanya dengan makna serupa.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Kata Kerja Diikuti to + Infinitif atau -ing (Gerund)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk kata kerja turunan yang tepat setelah kata kerja utama.

questions.q: 1. We decided [BLANK] our holidays in Greece this summer.
questions.explanation: Kata kerja 'decide' selalu diikuti oleh 'to + infinitive'.

questions.q: 2. My father enjoys [BLANK] historical fiction novels.
questions.explanation: Kata kerja 'enjoy' selalu diikuti oleh bentuk gerund (-ing).

questions.q: 3. Don't forget [BLANK] the door before you go to bed.
questions.explanation: 'forget to + infinitive' bermakna ingat untuk melakukan suatu tindakan.

questions.q: 4. She avoids [BLANK] sugary drinks when she is on a diet.
questions.explanation: 'avoid' diikuti oleh kata kerja bentuk -ing (gerund).

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Percakapan Rencana Andy & Angela (Audio TR 22)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan percakapan Andy dan Angela pada audio TR 22, lalu pilih jawaban yang tepat.

questions.q: 2. Apa yang ingin dilakukan Andy pada hari Sabtu malam?

questions.q: 3. Mengapa Andy tidak bisa menjemput Angela dengan mobilnya di rumah?
options: Andy sudah berjanji meminjamkan mobilnya kepada saudara laki-lakinya.
questions.answer: Andy sudah berjanji meminjamkan mobilnya kepada saudara laki-lakinya.
